title: Entry into force of the Fiji-Australia Vuvale Union and Ocean of Peace Alliance (Veitacini Treaty)
summary: The Prime Minister of Australia, the Hon Anthony Albanese MP, and the Prime Minister of Fiji, the Hon Sitiveni Rabuka, today mark the entry into force of the Vuvale Union and Ocean of Peace Alliance. These landmark agreements open a new chapter in our strategic partnership.

title: Private investment booming under Labor
summary: Data out today shows capital expenditure (CAPEX) is booming in Australia. It is a stunning set of numbers that show Australia’s economy has a lot going for it. Despite all the challenges coming at us, Australia’s private sector is investing, growing and building and that is good news for our economy.
